title: 青少年体育支出五年增46%私募股权涌入引争议
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Family spending on youth sports is up 46 percent over the last five years.
segments.zh: 过去五年，家庭在青少年体育上的支出增长了46%。

segments.en: Our senior reporter, Randall Williams, he covers business of sports has been following this story and he joins us now.
segments.zh: 我们的资深记者兰德尔·威廉姆斯，他负责体育商业报道，一直在追踪这个故事，现在他加入我们。

segments.en: And Randall by some estimates, this is a $40 billion plus industry that is funded by private equity.
segments.zh: 兰德尔，据估计，这是一个由私募股权资助的超过400亿美元的产业。

segments.en: And so no surprise then has become hyper competitive and hyper specialized.
segments.zh: 所以毫不奇怪，它变得高度竞争和高度专业化。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, when private equity gets into something, of course, they want to maximize profit and that's not always a good thing for youth sports.
segments.zh: 是的，当私募股权介入时，他们当然想最大化利润，这对青少年体育来说并不总是好事。

segments.en: People think of youth sports as the level before college sports.
segments.zh: 人们认为青少年体育是大学体育之前的阶段。

segments.en: And college sports, of course, is welcoming private equity as well. But with NIO with a bunch of different mechanisms, we, it's sort of the amateur level.
segments.zh: 而大学体育当然也在欢迎私募股权。但有了NIL和各种机制，它有点像业余水平。

segments.en: And I think youth sports isn't meant to be that, but it's becoming that because you can identify talent earlier on, which therefore could lead to brand collaborations and so many other things.
segments.zh: 我认为青少年体育本不应该是那样，但它正在变成那样，因为你可以更早地发现人才，从而可能带来品牌合作等等。

segments.en: So youth sports is a huge industry that we're seeing private equity get into and other investors as well.
segments.zh: 所以青少年体育是一个巨大的产业，我们看到私募股权和其他市场参与者正在进入。

segments.en: How has technology accelerated this? Because we talk about private equity getting in, we talk about NIL, that those are two distinct things.
segments.zh: 技术如何加速了这一进程？因为我们谈论私募股权进入，谈论NIL，这是两件不同的事情。

segments.en: But technology has made it even more hyper intense.
segments.zh: 但科技让竞争更加激烈。

segments.en: Well, it's interesting like when I was growing up, like my dad and my mom would have a film camera that they would shoot it for.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，我小时候父母会用胶片相机拍摄。

segments.en: But that was just for fun. Like I had my aspirations of going to the NFL ended at 15.
segments.zh: 但那只是娱乐，我15岁就放弃了NFL梦想。

segments.en: But now you have people using apps like Game Changer, which you can literally just film the entire thing, create a highlight reel for your child, and then email it to Scouts Themselves.
segments.zh: 现在人们用Game Changer等应用全程录像，制作精彩集锦，直接电邮给球探。
